ideas.title: Postgres Generates Duplicate IDs After a Manual Import Leaves the Sequence Behind
ideas.description: Postgres inserts collide when an imported table’s sequence is lower than existing rows; reset the sequence to match the data.
ideas.angle: Start with the concrete failure: `duplicate key value violates unique constraint` on an auto-increment column. Explain how `SERIAL` or identity columns depend on a sequence, why bulk imports or manual inserts can leave the sequence behind, and how that creates collisions. Show the SQL to inspect the current value and advance the sequence to `max(id)`.

ideas.title: Dockerfile Builds a Next.js App, Then Node Crashes with "ERR_OSSL_EVP_UNSUPPORTED"
ideas.description: A Docker image with the wrong Node or OpenSSL version can break Next.js builds; align the base image and runtime.
ideas.angle: Open with the build or startup error exactly as it appears inside the container. Explain why Next.js or its transitive dependencies can fail when the image pins an older Node/OpenSSL combo than the lockfile expects. Cover choosing a compatible base image, matching build and runtime stages, and verifying the Node version inside the container.

ideas.title: SvelteKit Tests Throw ReferenceError: window is not defined in JSDOM
ideas.description: Why browser globals are missing in SvelteKit tests and how to run server-only code under a DOM-aware test environment.
ideas.angle: Cover how SvelteKit test files can execute modules in Node before JSDOM is installed, which leaves `window` undefined. Explain the boundary between server-only modules and browser-only code, then show how to configure Vitest, move DOM access behind `onMount`, or mock globals when the code must stay server-side.

ideas.title: Node CLI Fails with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM When `require()` Loads an ESM Dependency
ideas.description: Why a published Node CLI crashes on startup when CommonJS reaches an ESM-only package, and how to fix the import boundary.
ideas.angle: Explain that `require()` cannot load an ESM-only dependency, so the CLI breaks before its entry point runs. Cover the conditions that trigger the error, including `type`, `.cjs` and `.mjs` files, and package exports, then show the valid fixes: switch the CLI to ESM, use dynamic `import()`, or pin a CommonJS-compatible version.

ideas.title: Hono Sends an Empty Response When a Handler Forgets to Return `c.text()`
ideas.description: How a Hono route can finish without a body when the handler does not return the response object.
ideas.angle: Describe how Hono expects the handler to return a `Response` and how falling through leaves the framework with no payload to send. Explain the control flow, especially inside async handlers and middleware chains, then show the fix: return the result of `c.text()`, `c.json()`, or `await next()` appropriately.

ideas.title: Cloudflare Workers Scheduled Triggers Never Run Because the Cron Pattern Is Missing from `wrangler.toml`
ideas.description: Why a Worker deploys successfully but its scheduled job never fires, and how to register the cron trigger correctly.
ideas.angle: Cover how Cloudflare only attaches scheduled events when the cron expression is declared in `wrangler.toml` or the dashboard, so the worker deploys without any trigger. Explain the runtime mechanism for `scheduled()` and the difference between a deployed script and an active schedule, then show the exact configuration and verification steps.

ideas.title: Bun Publishes a CLI That Runs Without `node_modules/.bin` When the Binary Field Is Wrong
ideas.description: How a Bun package can ship successfully but expose no working command because the bin entry points at the wrong file.
ideas.angle: Explain how package managers resolve the `bin` field and why a bad path or missing shebang leaves the installed command unusable. Cover Bun-specific publishing details, the executable bit, and the difference between local test runs and installed package behavior, then show how to point `bin` at the real entry file and verify it after packing.

ideas.title: Vite Builds Succeed but the Server Serves the Wrong `dist` Folder
ideas.description: Why a deployment can show an old or empty app after a successful Vite build, and how to point the server at the right output.
ideas.angle: Cover the case where the build command writes one output directory but the host, adapter, or static server serves another path. Explain how Vite emits assets, why stale build directories and mismatched root settings cause the wrong files to be served, then show how to align `root`, `build.outDir`, and the deployment target.

ideas.title: Next.js Route Handlers Throw TypeError: Body has already been read After Parsing `request.json()` Twice
ideas.description: Why a Next.js route handler fails after the request body is consumed more than once, and how to preserve the stream.
ideas.angle: Explain the fetch body model: a request stream can be consumed only once, so a second `request.json()`, `text()`, or `formData()` call throws. Cover why this happens in route handlers and middleware, then show the fix by reading once, cloning before consumption when needed, or passing the parsed object through.

drafted.title: Deno Fails a Fetch Call with "Requires net access" in a Worker
drafted.description: Deno blocks outbound requests without the right permission flags or allowlist; grant network access for the target host.
drafted.angle: Open with the exact permission error from `fetch()` or a library call. Explain Deno's permission model, why worker and script contexts still need explicit `--allow-net` or deployment-specific permission settings, and how host allowlists affect the request. Include the exact command-line flag and a safer scoped permission example.
